description: Schedules a drafted campaign to send to its audience. This is not reversible once sending starts, and it uses one email of quota per recipient. Call campaign_preview first, tell the person the audience count and the quota it uses, and only call this after they say yes. Pass the audience count you showed them as expected_audience_count; if the list changed meaningfully the call is refused. A workspace's first campaign is held for a one-time human review instead of sending (review_pending); say so plainly and do not retry. Before send_at, campaign_cancel can still stop it. Requires API key scope: send.

confirm.description: Must be true, and only after the person explicitly approved this send and its audience count.

expected_audience_count.description: The audience count you showed the person from campaign_preview.

id.description: Campaign id (a UUID), as returned by campaign_draft or campaigns_list.

send_at.description: "now", or an ISO 8601 time with timezone such as 2026-10-05T09:00:00-07:00.

name: campaign_schedule
title: Schedule campaign
